list.name: scenario
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT scenario FROM realy.runs ORDER BY scenario

panels.title: e2e p99 by scenario
panels.description: One point per run. A step up after a deploy is a regression; `realy gate` fails CI on it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, scenario, e2e_p99_ms FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) ORDER BY time
SELECT started_at AS time, scenario, hot_path_p99_ms FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) ORDER BY time

panels.title: knee (TPS where p99 breaks)
panels.description: step-ramp / ramp runs: the load at which latency breaks the budget or a backlog builds

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, scenario, knee_tps FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND knee_tps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: CPU per event
panels.description: Input to `realy size`: a cost regression shows here before it shows up as latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, concat(scenario, ' gateway') AS series, gateway_cpu_ms_per_event FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND gateway_cpu_ms_per_event IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, concat(scenario, ' flink') AS series, flink_cpu_ms_per_event FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND flink_cpu_ms_per_event IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT started_at AS time, concat(scenario, ' recall') AS series, recall_flagged FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND recall_flagged IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, concat(scenario, ' FPR') AS series, false_positive_rate FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND false_positive_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: feature exactness (verify)
panels.description: Served features vs independent recomputation: 1.0 on flink-inline; gateway topology with state blobs targets >= 0.99

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, scenario, exact_set_agreement FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) AND exact_set_agreement IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT started_at, run_id, scenario, topology, verdict, achieved_tps, e2e_p99_ms, hot_path_p99_ms, within_budget, missing, duplicates, knee_tps, verify_passed, exact_set_agreement, git_sha FROM realy.runs FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND scenario IN (${scenario:singlequote}) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100
